author: Noema I
title: No-PE + Concat MHA (5 blocks, kernel_size=5, attn_temp=0.5)
abstract: No-PE best setup with smaller kernel (5) in 5 dilated DSConv blocks and tau=0.5 attention to test if tighter local filters improve CRISPR without harming MRL/ncRNA.
